result.keyword: What's the best accounting software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For a small business in Australia, my top recommendation would be **Xero**\. It's an excellent all-round accounting platform, particularly if you want to manage invoices, expenses, GST, BAS and payroll without making bookkeeping overly complicated.

However, the best choice depends on the size and type of your business.

## My top 5 accounting software picks

![Small business, big stress – and finding the right balance for success](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/js_DP_ZcJt2b0HYevLiH8RyWaqBcysH-7umi2-OpUv1L_c7R6GqF2ePsaUUNhFEx0xoCJM9UhE2ygbfJvKTZATLo4fmY2I8PpXkEP4z5gNTNS9QARFCTPWNcGDYwVCjusvLzfwG5BpY7OHDvJf-Gvvkz7eUnU1rkY8PEcDFGKBEcxvEb1v6GA_F2cLDI9Uk_?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Xero**

(Best overall)

- Excellent bank reconciliation and invoicing.
- GST and BAS management.
- Payroll and superannuation features.
- Great accountant and bookkeeper integrations.

Best for: Most small businesses wanting room to grow.

Australian plans start around \$37/month.

[Xero website](https://www.xero.com/au/)

---

![MYOB - Features, Reviews & Pricing (February 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RSnJXDEAckMg49Z3Uyl1ySpGe5Mf5xY-fiHvWrkutyMlRVsk_cizHWnHbb0_8J0spngX92NOecbYb0xtPztOW_1U5_j589rcfR6e_7DzDwZO-F8qM8BNDHiplH9bI1r3qal9-SnHWVHGyS5SP06Y1atDJc1eUMWI1ht7KCGJtRhy8le1UHOPMDyYDZIt-Ehu?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. MYOB**

(Best for payroll)

- Strong Australian tax and compliance features.
- Payroll and employee management.
- BAS and GST reporting.
- Good option for businesses with employees.

Best for: Businesses with staff and more involved payroll.

[MYOB website](https://www.myob.com/au)

---

![Quickbooks Online — Columbus Business Consulting](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/z_-lMr1rk7nVCnHpykvHbFlLn1azsDdLq1E5IPLLHaY_8oSNYyauUS0LtpVtMtsr7aGmH36ThTapoKB2Ph5Q3eMVc_UXwvW966z4ZTJF_6xHgqWw4BiwFU5MO1xbGE5oY_mXKemXduz1fPiAwGEyT1jt_IjAl-f9situ1bcy769twmRe-HD-uB1wI8CWqiLV?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. QuickBooks**

- Good financial reporting.
- Invoicing and expense tracking.
- Useful business integrations.
- Straightforward day-to-day bookkeeping.

Best for: Small businesses wanting comprehensive reporting.

[QuickBooks Australia](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/au/)

---

![Reckon Payroll 2026 Pricing, Features, Reviews & Alternatives | GetApp](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ACef1V9QbM8Y3LxjLzJIQV-TfChUBjwyyx7W6AOhVMywuWusbhYulcZYBn3S8A-J1ZSIIaQtu8WMi3CVnQm3fE7mKMbBw3Beo_sQTtWxx5CDDP34nqzqL6m70W1jmud24Hdj0BDI4_JPvo8A-h8b5n6w-92zDw-PxjtUuoZZ2u15XApkZg7xxx4sYiZVnXkz?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Reckon**

- Affordable accounting options.
- GST and BAS tools.
- Invoicing and expense management.

Best for: Smaller businesses wanting to keep software costs down.

[Reckon website](https://www.reckon.com/au/)

---

!["Best 10 Zoho Apps for Small Businesses in 2024 - Must-Have Tools" | C3 Solutions](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/QMBJut4kUVy6UNtA0DcEcpSKElNdEgHfabBOoR3AWTMUo6phHjAJ01KBTRk_iU44CUuVy6AD0OeM48UFtluYC3mtudqFVjYFesk47WQPcQQfsgxz1-Ctp0z-lODm5vgYFvDQ7IEjwcEwqAsNX1booH4Twqog2tqxnwaLYmRuRR9TviU8hG6khxNJKfVoO6Q2?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Zoho Books**

- Good automation.
- Invoicing and expense tracking.
- Useful integration with other Zoho products.
- Free plan available for eligible smaller businesses.

Best for: Sole traders and startups looking for value.

[Zoho Books website](https://www.zoho.com/au/books/)

## Which one would I choose?

| Business type | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Sole trader | Xero or Zoho Books |
| Small business with employees | MYOB or Xero |
| Tradie or contractor | Xero |
| Retail business | Xero or MYOB |
| Consulting business | Xero |
| Very tight budget | Zoho Books or Reckon |
